item.title: How to Expand a Patio Drip Kit Without Losing Pressure
item.description: Method note: This guide is built for growers who started with a small patio or balcony drip kit, then did the predictable thing and added more containers until the system started acting weird. Disclosure: This guide contains affiliate links. We earn a commission if you purchase through these links — at no extra cost to you. See affiliate disclosure for details. A patio drip kit usually works great right up until you get optimistic.
